title: The Babadook
about: A grieving mother and her son are haunted by a sinister storybook creature.
cue: Serve dessert when Amelia reads the pop-up book.
faces: OPEN LATE. MIND THE QUIET CORNER
“Samuel, no gadgets at the table. Eat your dinner and then we read something nice, not that book.”
A pop-up storybook. Ten stamps. Nobody remembers the tenth.
